title: Cartwise+ Membership Upgrade Credit for a Period Paid by Retry
content:
When a Cartwise+ Membership member on a monthly plan moves up to Cartwise+ Annual, the upgrade credit for a current period whose fee was captured as a retry is measured as follows.

**Rule.**

1. When the current period's fee was captured as a retry for less than the plan's period fee, the whole fee captured for the period is credited, because the retry already settled only part of the period.
2. When the current period's fee was captured as a retry for the plan's period fee or more, the fee captured is credited for the whole weeks of the period still ahead: the fee multiplied by the whole weeks from today up to the renewal date multiplied by 7, divided by the days in the period.
3. When the current period's fee was not captured as a retry, neither 1 nor 2 applies.

The credit is rounded to the cent.

## Figures the rule turns on — the plan's period fee

| Monthly plan held | Period fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 4.49 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 4.99 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 9.99 |

For completeness, the annual plans' period fees are 99.00 (Cartwise+ Annual), 119.00 (Cartwise+ Family Annual) and 179.00 (Cartwise+ Premier Annual).

## Terms

- **Captured as a retry**: the membership shows a fee charge of the renewal-retry type whose billing period start is the current period's first day.
- **Fee captured for the period**: every fee charge whose billing period start is the current period's first day, totalled.
- **Whole weeks ahead**: the calendar days from today up to the day before the renewal date, divided by 7, any part week dropped.

## Hypothetical cases (Cartwise+ Monthly, period 12 April to 12 May, 30 days, today 20 April, 22 days ahead)

| Fee captured for the period | Captured as a retry | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 4.20 | yes | the whole 4.20 |
| 9.99 | yes | 3 whole weeks, 21 days: 9.99 multiplied by 21, divided by 30, which is 6.99 |
| 9.99 | no | not measured under 1 or 2 |
